name: Fort York
note: Every building inside the ramparts gets 1815: the fort was rebuilt from late 1813 and completed in 1815 (Wikipedia; the Heritage Register gives 'Fort York, 1813-15, Royal Engineers'), and the last year of a range is used. Wrong for the Blue Barracks, a reconstruction of 1986, and for a few small modern service buildings, which I could not tell apart from the others. Heights are capped at 9 m because the lidar heights of two buildings (about 19 m) take in trees; OpenStreetMap gives one or two storeys. Outline: OpenStreetMap way 1416813033 (ODbL); the ramparts were rebuilt in 1838, the 1860s and the 1930s, so the outline is today's.
